title: Header tails remove packed rows
statement: Let $l,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $row$ assign a finite binary word to each time and each of the $l$ field positions, and let $tail$ be a finite binary word. Taking $n l$ iterated header tails of the concatenation of the packed first $n$ rows and $tail$ yields exactly $tail$.
hypotheses_covered: A family of finite binary words indexed by time and by $l$ field positions
replaced: For every row family with $l$ fields per row, count $n$, and trailer, following $n \cdot l$ header tails of the stream of the first $n$ rows followed by the trailer returns the literal trailer.
